company.name: Zeplin
company.shortDescription: Zeplin is a collaboration tool between designers and developers to publish finalized designs
company.description: Zeplin is an organized workspace to publish finalized designs, where the entire team can collaborate to ship beautiful products together. The company supports 5+ million users from thousands of product teams including Apple, Starbucks, Salesforce, Amazon, Microsoft, Audi, and many more. Zeplin is a Y Combinator startup, also backed by amazing investors like Elad Gil, Mike Maples, and Kevin Hale.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that publishes finalized designs to facilitate collaboration between designers and developers, providing a centralized workspace for design handoff and documentation.
productsAndServices.name: Zeplin Design Delivery Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool for developers to analyze and track usage and performance of design components within projects.
productsAndServices.name: Omlet Component Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A feature that exports design tokens and syncs components and styles from design tools to code in multiple programming languages.
productsAndServices.name: Design System Sync and Export

productsAndServices.description: Tools to map user journeys, document design intent, and annotate designs with requirements and behaviors for team collaboration.
productsAndServices.name: User Flows and Documentation

productsAndServices.description: Integrations with design, development, and collaboration tools to automate workflows and connect design delivery with existing tech stacks.
productsAndServices.name: Integrations and Workflow Automation

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $461,279 to $10,161,933, a 22.03x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 4 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 24 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
